description: Synthetic, de-identified rejection-feedback samples used for human groundedness and quality evaluation of the refinement prompt in English and Spanish. No production feedback may be added to this file. Expectations describe what a reviewer must verify; they are not byte-matched in CI. Preserve the input language. Score invented claims, decisions, requirements, examples or next steps, and lost or corrupted key details as groundedness defects. Track readability and repetition misses separately. An explicit safety omission takes precedence over detail preservation; record it separately rather than marking unsafe-content removal as a groundedness defect. Report content-filter blocks separately from scored model outputs.
